Title: F-PAR-001 AC-01: Parent registration options
Objective: Parent can register independently or be auto-prompted during student registration when student age < 13
Preconditions: Clean test DB; student with age <13 exists for auto-prompt path
Steps: 1) Register parent directly; 2) Simulate student <13 registration flow and confirm parent prompt
Expected Result: Parent account created and parent prompted/linked when student <13
DB Validation: SELECT id, phone, role FROM users WHERE role='parent' AND phone ILIKE 'test%';
Notes: Verify email/SMS verification

Title: F-PAR-001 AC-02: Required parent registration fields
Objective: Parent registration requires mobile OTP, name, relationship
Preconditions: Clean DB and SMS gateway test config
Steps: 1) Attempt registration without OTP -> expect block; 2) Complete OTP flow with required fields
Expected Result: Registration succeeds only after OTP verification and required fields present
DB Validation: SELECT id, phone, name, relationship FROM users WHERE role='parent' AND phone='<phone>';
Notes: Verify OTP logs and audit

Title: F-PAR-001 AC-03: Mandatory parent verification for <13
Objective: If student age <13, parent account creation & verification mandatory before student activation
Steps: 1) Register student with DOB <13 without parent verification -> expect block; 2) Create parent & verify OTP -> activate student
Expected Result: Student account remains inactive until parent verified
DB Validation: SELECT id, parent_id, status FROM users WHERE email='student@example.com';
Notes: Check SMS delivery logs for parent OTP

Title: F-PAR-001 AC-04: Optional linking for >=13
Objective: If student age ≥13 parent linking is optional; student may invite parent later
Steps: 1) Register student age >=13; 2) Attempt to proceed without parent; 3) Invite parent later via profile
Expected Result: Student account active and parent link optional
DB Validation: SELECT id, parent_id FROM users WHERE email='teen@example.com';
Notes: Ensure invite flow secure

Title: F-PAR-001 AC-05: Max child links per parent
Objective: Parent may link up to 3 child profiles
Steps: 1) Link 3 child profiles; 2) Attempt to add 4th -> expect error
Expected Result: Parent linked to up to 3 children; 4th request rejected
DB Validation: SELECT parent_id, count(*) FROM parent_child WHERE parent_id = '<parent_id>' GROUP BY parent_id;
Notes: Edge-case: family plan enforcement

Title: F-PAR-001 AC-06: Parent cannot alter child sessions
Objective: Parent account cannot change child's learning sessions or progress
Steps: 1) As parent attempt to modify child session records; 2) Verify permission denied
Expected Result: Parent receives 403 when attempting to modify child sessions
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE actor_role='parent' AND action LIKE '%session%';
Notes: Verify separation of privileges

Title: F-PAR-001 AC-07: Welcome & verification notices
Objective: Parent receives verification SMS + welcome email with privacy summary
Steps: 1) Complete parent registration; 2) Check email_queue and sms_queue for welcome messages
Expected Result: Welcome email and SMS queued with privacy snippet
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM email_queue WHERE to = '<parent_email>' AND template ILIKE '%welcome%';
